top_stories.title: In the agentic era, standing privilege must go: Key thoughts from the SailPoint Navigate keynote
top_stories.summary: SailPoint used its Navigate 2026 conference keynote in Austin to shift its positioning toward real-time access prevention, moving beyond traditional identity governance toward eliminating standing privileges. The announcement signals a strategic product and vision direction change for SailPoint, emphasizing agentic AI era identity security.

top_stories.title: SailPoint adds AI agent discovery, temporary access and compliance automation
top_stories.summary: SailPoint has announced new capabilities including AI agent discovery, temporary access, and compliance automation across its SailPoint Agentic Fabric and SailPoint Human Fabric products. The features are built on the SailPoint Atlas platform and aim to give enterprises greater visibility and control over identity governance.

top_stories.title: Four Providers, 15 CVEs, Three Days — The Agent Identity Stack Is Under Coordinated Attack
top_stories.summary: Between October 2–5, 2026, four identity-layer providers were hit with 15 CVEs in a coordinated three-day window, affecting ZITADEL (10 CVEs), Zimbra, Bouncy Castle, and MCP OAuth credential theft. The vulnerabilities target the agent identity stack, spanning authentication libraries, OAuth flows, and identity infrastructure components.

top_stories.title: The people who know passkeys best are still typing passwords
top_stories.summary: Yubico and Okta's 2026 Global State of Authentication Report surveyed 1,890 technology and security professionals across nine countries about their workplace sign-in methods. Despite 87% reporting familiarity with passkeys, 43% still use username and password as their primary authentication method, with half having been issued credentials in that format at the start of their current role.

top_stories.title: High Awareness, Low Adoption: New Survey Reveals Nearly Half of Security Professionals Still Rely on Passwords
top_stories.summary: A joint survey by Yubico and Okta found that nearly half of security professionals still rely on passwords despite widespread awareness of stronger authentication alternatives. The global study highlights an adoption gap in enterprise security regarding modern identity controls and passwordless authentication.

news.title: GitHub adds AI to catch passwords before a code push
news.summary: GitHub has launched an AI-powered credential detector, built with Microsoft Applied Sciences using a ModernBERT-based classifier, to expand its push protection feature in code repositories. The tool goes beyond format-based secret detection by analyzing surrounding code context to identify unstructured secrets such as database passwords before they enter repository history.

news.title: U.S. Offers Up to $10 Million for Tips on Zhang Yu, Charged in HAFNIUM Hacks
news.summary: The U.S. State Department is offering up to $10 million for information on Zhang Yu, a Chinese national charged in connection with the 2021 HAFNIUM Microsoft Exchange Server attacks. The HAFNIUM campaign exploited zero-day vulnerabilities in Microsoft Exchange Server, compromising tens of thousands of organizations' email and identity infrastructure worldwide.

news.title: SonicWall Patches CVSS 10.0 Pre-Authentication SSRF Flaw in SMA1000 Appliances
news.summary: SonicWall has released hotfixes addressing four vulnerabilities in its SMA1000 appliances, including a CVSS 10.0 pre-authentication SSRF flaw. The critical flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send requests through the appliance to reach internal network functions, affecting remote access gateway infrastructure.

news.title: FBI Warns FortiBleed Remains Active After Amassing 86,644 Fortinet Device Credentials
news.summary: The FBI and Secret Service warned that the FortiBleed campaign remains active, having harvested 86,644 credentials from Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways. The campaign exploits reused or leaked credentials and legacy SHA-256 password storage on internet-facing Fortinet devices.

news.title: Fake ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude Ad Portals Capture Credentials and MFA Codes
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have identified a human-operated phishing platform that impersonates advertising portals for major AI chatbots including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to steal credentials and MFA codes. The platform lures victims with fake services such as campaign optimization and spend audits, ultimately capturing authentication factors to compromise accounts.

news.title: Half of Cybersecurity Pros Still Rely on Passwords Despite Security Concerns
news.summary: A Yubico survey found that half of cybersecurity professionals still rely on passwords as a primary authentication method despite awareness of associated security risks. The survey highlights a gap between knowledge of more secure authentication methods and their actual adoption within enterprise environments.

news.title: Stop Hoping for Secure AI and Start Building It: RSA Agent ID Closes the Agentic Identity Gap for Highly Regulated Industries
news.summary: RSA has launched Agent ID, a product designed to address identity and authentication challenges for AI agents operating in regulated industries such as finance and government. The solution enables organizations to discover and register AI agents, verify authorization for actions taken by those agents, and supports flexible deployment options.

news.title: Welcome to the Jungle: What We Found Inside 15,465 Public MCP Servers
news.summary: OX Security researchers analyzed 15,465 public MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and found critical security vulnerabilities in the ecosystem. The research touches on authentication and authorization weaknesses in AI agent infrastructure connecting models and tools.

news.title: Denmark Says Attackers Accessed CPR Data for 8.8 Million People via Company Account
news.summary: Attackers accessed Denmark's Central Person Register (CPR) through a compromised private company account, exposing names, addresses, and personal identification numbers for 8.8 million people. The breach exploited legitimate business access credentials rather than a direct system vulnerability, highlighting risks in third-party access management to sensitive government identity data.

news.title: SailPoint’s 40x Gap — Enterprise AI Agent Adoption Has Outrun Identity Security by a Factor of 40
news.summary: SailPoint's Navigate 2026 conference in Austin highlighted a significant gap between enterprise AI agent adoption and identity security capabilities, with data showing AI agent deployment outpacing identity security by a factor of 40. The findings were presented at SailPoint's annual conference, underscoring the challenge IGA platforms face in governing non-human identities at scale.

news.title: Improving SPIRE security and resiliency with AWS managed services
news.summary: The article covers improving SPIRE (SPIFFE Runtime Environment) security and resiliency using AWS managed services for workload identity in cloud environments. SPIRE is an open-source implementation of the SPIFFE standard for workload identity and authentication in machine-to-machine communication, replacing traditional static credentials like API keys and shared secrets.

news.title: Identity-aware AI data agents with AWS Lake Formation and Trusted Identity Propagation
news.summary: AWS has published guidance on building identity-aware AI data agents using AWS Lake Formation and Trusted Identity Propagation to enforce access governance policies within AI-driven lakehouse queries. The approach enables AI agents to respect existing IAM-based data access controls by propagating user identity through the query pipeline rather than granting the agent broad permissions.

news.title: Fake ChatGPT, Gemini Sites steal advertising accounts, MFA codes
news.summary: A malicious campaign is targeting advertising account managers using fake AI tool websites (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) to steal login credentials and MFA codes via browser-in-browser attacks. The attack method bypasses multi-factor authentication by intercepting MFA codes in real time through the spoofed browser interface.

news.title: When identity isn’t human: securing the agentic enterprise
news.summary: The article addresses securing AI agents in enterprise environments through identity governance and runtime controls. It focuses on non-human identity management, continuous authentication, and governance frameworks applied to agentic AI systems.

news.title: FusionAuth Establishes UK Team as European Demand for Data Sovereignty Drives 72% Regional Growth
news.summary: FusionAuth, a customer identity and access management (CIAM) platform, has established its first dedicated UK sales team following 72% regional growth in Europe. The expansion is driven by enterprise demand for data sovereignty and tenant isolation, with the company reporting 48% new-business ARR growth in Q1.

news.title: The Credential Layer Is Expanding Faster Than Security Teams Can See It
news.summary: GitGuardian published a promotional overview of its credential security platform, describing three core capabilities: detecting, remediating, and preventing credential exposure across enterprise environments. The article focuses on the expanding "credential layer" encompassing human, system, and AI identities connecting to data and services.

news.title: Apple Plans Tighter macOS Full Disk Access Controls Over AI Agent Data Access
news.summary: Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access (FDA) controls in response to security risks posed by AI agents accessing sensitive user data. The change targets developers who use FDA permissions to expose files, mail, messages, and browsing history without users' full awareness.

news.title: Keeper Security Surpasses 100,000 Enterprise Customers as Organizations Consolidate Identity Security Solutions in the Agentic Era
news.summary: Keeper Security announced it has surpassed 100,000 enterprise customers for its zero-trust and zero-knowledge identity security platform. The milestone reflects enterprise consolidation of identity security solutions amid growing adoption of agentic AI technologies.

news.title: tenfold CE: Our free Identity Governance tool just got 2 new features
news.summary: tenfold has added shared content governance and real-time event auditing to its free Community Edition identity governance tool for organizations with under 150 users. The new features target Microsoft 365 sharing management and suspicious identity activity investigation.

news.title: Kiteworks & Citrix Incidents Show Challenges of Zero-Day Response
news.summary: Kiteworks and Citrix faced separate zero-day incidents requiring emergency response measures, with Kiteworks instructing customers to power down its data-protection platform during a nine-hour window. Citrix did not communicate with customers about reported attacks prior to releasing a patch, highlighting contrasting approaches to zero-day disclosure and incident response.

news.title: SWIFT Banking & Government Middleware Enables RCE
news.summary: A vulnerability in SWIFT banking and government middleware has been identified that enables remote code execution (RCE). The flaw can be exploited to bypass hardware-based MFA in high-security environments, with a patch recommended to mitigate the risk.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach of the identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based access to Snowflake accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.
